The property asserts: every admin aggregation request must be from a user where `is_admin == true`.

- `src/app/admin/layout.tsx::AdminLayout` — gates the `/admin` route tree; checks `is_admin` (line 20-22). This protects `/admin/*` only.

- `src/app/actions.ts::getOverallStats`, `getDailyAttendanceCounts`, `getDailyAttendanceDetails` — the server actions that return cross-user data. All use `createSupabaseAdminClient()` (bypasses RLS) and perform no auth/admin check.
